attributes.action: Bank Holiday for Monday 6th July for the England Match
attributes.background: England have progressed to the last 16 of the World Cup. The next match is at 1am on Monday 6th July. Make the Monday an official Bank Holiday so the country can support the team and not have to worry about work or school

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
